---
title: "FRAP: bootstrap of the tri-exponential fits to the slow-regime average curves"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
if (!requireNamespace("minpack.lm", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("minpack.lm")
library(minpack.lm)
```

Bootstrap of the slow-regime tri-exponential fits (companion to
`FRAP_slow_triexp_fit.Rmd`; the fitting functions are copied from there).

Each iteration resamples the slow ROIs of a cell line with replacement (all
replicates pooled), averages them, and fits the same resampled curve in 9
versions (all unweighted, full multi-start):

| version | taken from the quick bi-exponential bootstrap |
|---|---|
| unconstrained | nothing |
| k1,k2 fixed | k1, k2 held exactly |
| k1,k2 bounded | k1, k2 within value ± 1 SD |
| frac fixed | frac_A1, k1, frac_A2, k2 held exactly (C free, A = frac × (1 − C)) |
| frac bounded | frac_A1, k1, frac_A2, k2 within value ± 1 SD |

Every constrained version is run with two sources of the quick values:

* **median**: the quick bootstrap medians, in every iteration
* **random**: one randomly drawn quick bootstrap iteration per slow iteration
  (all constrained values from that same quick iteration; both random-draw
  versions of one slow iteration use the same draw). Bounded boxes are centered
  on the drawn values, width ± 1 SD of the quick bootstrap.

Cell lines: HOXC10, HOXC13, HOXC10-13-10, HOXC13-10-13. Comparisons (tests and
violin plots): HOXC10 vs HOXC13, HOXC10-13-10 vs HOXC10, HOXC13 vs
HOXC13-10-13.

## Parameters

```{r params}
slow_curve_folder  <- "/Volumes/lionnt01lab/lionnt01labspace/Henry/FRAP/2026_08_analyze_all_3_slow_recovery_replicates/bootstrap_analysis"
quick_curve_folder <- "/Volumes/lionnt01lab/lionnt01labspace/Henry/FRAP/2026_08_analyze_all_3_quick_recovery_replicates/bootstrap_analysis"
# per-iteration csvs of the quick script's bi-exponential bootstrap
quick_bootstrap_folder <- file.path(quick_curve_folder, "bootstrap_results")
recursive <- TRUE

channel_to_model     <- "Halo-JFx650"
bootstrap_cell_lines <- c("HOXC10", "HOXC13", "HOXC10-13-10", "HOXC13-10-13")

# Pairwise comparisons (tests and plots). Order = left/right in the plots, and
# direction of the differences (first - second) in the p-value plots.
comparisons <- list(c("HOXC10",       "HOXC13"),
                    c("HOXC10-13-10", "HOXC10"),
                    c("HOXC13",       "HOXC13-10-13"))

bleach_time <- 0   # csvs are already zeroed to the bleach event

# --- bootstrap ----------------------------------------------------------------
# TRUE: run the bootstrap and save the iterations.
# FALSE: read the previously saved iterations from export_folder instead.
run_bootstrap          <- FALSE
n_bootstrap_iterations <- 1000
set.seed(42)

# discard rules (same as the original scripts)
max_plateau_sum <- 1.5   # C + A1 + A2 + A3 above this -> discarded

# --- fitting ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Multi-start: n_start_taus log-spaced time constants between the shortest frame
# interval and the last time point. Unconstrained fit: every combination of 3 of
# them is one start (6 -> 20 starts). Constrained fits: each one is a start for
# k3. The best start that converged is kept.
n_start_taus <- 6
n_sd_bounds  <- 1        # bounded: value +/- n_sd_bounds * SD

# --- plots --------------------------------------------------------------------
cell_line_colors <- c(
  "HOXC10"       = "#2888c2",
  "HOXC10-13-10" = "#fd963a",
  "HOXC13"       = "#b81d19",
  "HOXC13-10-13" = "#8170b5"
)

status_colors <- c(kept                = "#4DAF4A",
                   fit_failed          = "#E41A1C",
                   hit_iteration_limit = "#FF7F00",
                   plateau_too_high    = "#984EA3",
                   rate_at_lower_bound = "#377EB8")

# violin shade (opacity of the cell-line color): full = estimated from the slow
# data, lighter = bounded around the quick value, lightest = held at the quick value
status_alpha <- c("estimated"         = 0.85,
                  "tied (bounded)"    = 0.45,
                  "inherited (fixed)" = 0.2)

violin_params <- c("C", "A1", "A2", "A3", "k1", "k2", "k3", "tau_1", "tau_2", "tau_3",
                   "frac_A1", "frac_A2", "frac_A3", "frac_unrecovered")

# --- tests --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Only these parameters form the Holm family (when estimated from the slow data).
# The amplitudes A and rates k are tested too, but not counted in the correction
# (fractions = A / (1 - C), tau = 1 / k carry the same information).
holm_params <- c("C", "frac_A1", "frac_A2", "frac_A3", "frac_unrecovered",
                 "tau_1", "tau_2", "tau_3")

# Parameters that are plotted but never tested (no test, no power estimate D).
# Empty: every plotted parameter is tested.
untested_params <- character(0)

# --- optional: how the p-values are derived -----------------------------------
# One version from the table below (e.g. "frac bounded | random"), or NULL to skip.
# For this version: difference histograms and single-version violins per comparison.
diff_plot_version <- "k1,k2 bounded | random"
# Parameters to show for that version; NULL = all tested parameters.
diff_plot_params  <- NULL
# Significance level for the minimum significant difference D (power estimate).
D_alpha <- 0.05/5
# Selected fit: parameters whose single-version violins are exported as PDFs
# (one PDF per parameter and comparison), together with the composition plots.
pdf_violin_params <- c("C", "frac_A1", "frac_A2", "frac_A3", "frac_unrecovered",
                       "tau_1", "tau_2", "tau_3")
# Selected fit: parameters whose violins (shown and PDF) get a log10 y axis.
# All other violin plots have a linear y axis that starts at 0 (or lower, if
# there are negative values).
log_y_params <- c("tau_3")
# Lower end of those log10 axes; ticks at powers of ten (10^0, 10^1, 10^2, ...).
# Values below this limit are not shown.
log_y_lower  <- 1
# Selected fit: parameters plotted once with all four cell lines side by side,
# with the brackets of the three tested comparisons (shown and exported as PDF).
all_lines_params <- c("tau_3")
# x-axis order of that plot (brackets between non-neighbours are stacked above)
all_lines_order  <- c("HOXC10", "HOXC10-13-10", "HOXC13-10-13", "HOXC13")

# --- export -------------------------------------------------------------------
export_folder <- file.path(slow_curve_folder, "slow_triexp_bootstrap")
dir.create(export_folder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## Versions

```{r versions}
families <- list("k1,k2"                 = c("k1", "k2"),
                 "frac_A1,k1,frac_A2,k2" = c("frac_A1", "k1", "frac_A2", "k2"))
family_label <- c("k1,k2" = "k1,k2", "frac_A1,k1,frac_A2,k2" = "frac")

versions <- expand_grid(family = names(families),
                        mode   = c("fixed", "bounded"),
                        source = c("median", "random")) %>%
  mutate(version = paste0(family_label[family], " ", mode, " | ", source))
versions <- bind_rows(
  tibble(family = "unconstrained", mode = "free", source = "none", version = "unconstrained"),
  versions
)
version_levels <- versions$version

versions %>% knitr::kable()
```

## Read slow-regime curves

```{r read}
files <- list.files(slow_curve_folder, pattern = "_individual_curves\\.csv$",
                    full.names = TRUE, recursive = recursive)
if (length(files) == 0) stop("No *_individual_curves.csv found in ", slow_curve_folder)

slow_curves <- files %>%
  map_dfr(read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ratio_targeted_to_untargeted),
         channel == channel_to_model,
         cell_line %in% bootstrap_cell_lines) %>%
  mutate(curve_id = paste(replicate, roi_id, sep = " | "))

slow_curves %>%
  distinct(cell_line, curve_id) %>%
  count(cell_line, name = "n_rois")
```

## Quick bi-exponential values

Median and SD per parameter over the converged quick bootstrap iterations
(`frac_A1`, `frac_A2` computed per iteration as `A / (1 - C)` if the quick
export has no `frac_*` columns). A zero or missing SD is replaced by 5 % of the
median. `pct_iter_k1_below_k2` is the share of quick iterations whose own k1 < k2;
those can be drawn in the "random" versions (flagged as `k1_below_k2` there).

```{r quick-priors}
quick_boot_files <- list.files(quick_bootstrap_folder,
                               pattern = "_bootstrap_iterations\\.csv$",
                               full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
if (length(quick_boot_files) == 0)
  stop("No quick bootstrap iteration csvs found in ", quick_bootstrap_folder)

quick_boot <- quick_boot_files %>%
  map_dfr(read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(converged, channel == channel_to_model, cell_line %in% bootstrap_cell_lines)

if (!all(c("frac_A1", "frac_A2") %in% names(quick_boot))) {
  quick_boot <- quick_boot %>% mutate(frac_A1 = A1 / (1 - C), frac_A2 = A2 / (1 - C))
}

quick_names <- c("C", "A1", "k1", "A2", "k2", "frac_A1", "frac_A2")

quick_prior <- quick_boot %>%
  group_by(cell_line) %>%
  summarize(
    n_quick_iterations   = n(),
    pct_iter_k1_below_k2 = 100 * mean(k1 < k2),
    across(all_of(quick_names),
           list(median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), sd = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
           .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

missing_lines <- setdiff(bootstrap_cell_lines, quick_prior$cell_line)
if (length(missing_lines) > 0)
  stop("No quick bootstrap values for: ", paste(missing_lines, collapse = ", "))

bad_order <- quick_prior %>% filter(k1_median < k2_median)
if (nrow(bad_order) > 0) {
  msg <- paste0("Quick bootstrap medians have k1 < k2 for: ",
                paste(bad_order$cell_line, collapse = ", "),
                ". Constraining would swap the meaning of components 1 and 2 - stopping.")
  warning(msg)
  stop(msg)
}

quick_prior %>% knitr::kable(digits = 4)

quick_median <- function(cl) {
  r <- quick_prior %>% filter(cell_line == cl) %>% slice(1)
  setNames(unlist(r[paste0(quick_names, "_median")]), quick_names)
}
quick_sd <- function(cl) {
  r <- quick_prior %>% filter(cell_line == cl) %>% slice(1)
  val <- setNames(unlist(r[paste0(quick_names, "_median")]), quick_names)
  sdv <- setNames(unlist(r[paste0(quick_names, "_sd")]), quick_names)
  bad <- !(is.finite(sdv) & sdv > 0)
  sdv[bad] <- pmax(abs(val[bad]) * 0.05, 1e-6)
  sdv
}
```

## Fitting functions

Copied from `FRAP_slow_triexp_fit.Rmd`, extended to report why a fit was not
usable:

* `fit_failed`: every start threw an error
* `hit_iteration_limit`: at least one start returned, but none converged
  (optimizer stopped at its iteration / function-evaluation limit)

Otherwise the best converged start is used.

$$y = C + A_1\left(1-e^{-k_1 t}\right) + A_2\left(1-e^{-k_2 t}\right) + A_3\left(1-e^{-k_3 t}\right)$$

```{r fit-helpers}
predict_tri <- function(p, t) {
  p[["C"]] +
    p[["A1"]] * (1 - exp(-p[["k1"]] * t)) +
    p[["A2"]] * (1 - exp(-p[["k2"]] * t)) +
    p[["A3"]] * (1 - exp(-p[["k3"]] * t))
}

start_tau_grid <- function(t) {
  t_pos <- sort(unique(t[t > 0]))
  exp(seq(log(min(diff(c(0, t_pos)))), log(max(t)), length.out = n_start_taus))
}

nls_control <- nls.lm.control(maxiter = 500, maxfev = 5000, ftol = 1e-10, ptol = 1e-10)

# nls.lm info codes 5 (maxfev) and 9 (maxiter) = stopped at a limit; 0 = bad input
pick_best <- function(outs) {
  returned <- Filter(function(o) !is.null(o) && o$info != 0, outs)
  if (length(returned) == 0) return(list(status = "fit_failed"))
  conv <- Filter(function(o) !(o$info %in% c(5, 9)), returned)
  if (length(conv) == 0) return(list(status = "hit_iteration_limit"))
  objs <- vapply(conv, function(o) sum(o$fvec^2), numeric(1))
  list(status = "ok", out = conv[[which.min(objs)]])
}

# ---- unconstrained -----------------------------------------------------------
# internal (C, A1, A2, A3, k3, d2, d1) -> natural; k1 >= k2 >= k3 by construction
to_natural_unc <- function(q) {
  c(C  = q[["C"]],
    A1 = q[["A1"]], k1 = q[["k3"]] + q[["d2"]] + q[["d1"]],
    A2 = q[["A2"]], k2 = q[["k3"]] + q[["d2"]],
    A3 = q[["A3"]], k3 = q[["k3"]])
}

fit_unconstrained <- function(t, y) {
  combos   <- combn(start_tau_grid(t), 3, simplify = FALSE)
  C0       <- min(max(y[which.min(t)], 0), 1)
  plateau0 <- mean(tail(y[order(t)], max(3, round(length(y) * 0.1))))
  A0       <- max(plateau0 - C0, 0.01) / 3

  resid_fn <- function(q) y - predict_tri(to_natural_unc(q), t)
  lower <- c(C = 0, A1 = 0,   A2 = 0,   A3 = 0,   k3 = 0,   d2 = 0,   d1 = 0)
  upper <- c(C = 1, A1 = Inf, A2 = Inf, A3 = Inf, k3 = Inf, d2 = Inf, d1 = Inf)

  outs <- lapply(combos, function(taus) {
    k <- sort(1 / taus, decreasing = TRUE)
    start <- c(C = C0, A1 = A0, A2 = A0, A3 = A0,
               k3 = k[3], d2 = k[2] - k[3], d1 = k[1] - k[2])
    tryCatch(nls.lm(par = start, lower = lower, upper = upper,
                    fn = resid_fn, control = nls_control),
             error = function(e) NULL)
  })

  best <- pick_best(outs)
  if (best$status != "ok") return(list(status = best$status))
  par <- to_natural_unc(best$out$par)
  list(status = "ok", par = par, rss = sum((y - predict_tri(par, t))^2))
}

# ---- constrained -------------------------------------------------------------
# k3 = s * k2 with 0 <= s <= 1, so k3 <= k2.
# Fraction version: A1 = frac_A1 * (1 - C), A2 = frac_A2 * (1 - C).
to_natural_con <- function(q) {
  if ("frac_A1" %in% names(q)) {
    A1 <- q[["frac_A1"]] * (1 - q[["C"]])
    A2 <- q[["frac_A2"]] * (1 - q[["C"]])
  } else {
    A1 <- q[["A1"]]
    A2 <- q[["A2"]]
  }
  c(C = q[["C"]], A1 = A1, k1 = q[["k1"]], A2 = A2, k2 = q[["k2"]],
    A3 = q[["A3"]], k3 = q[["s"]] * q[["k2"]])
}

# center: quick values used as fixed values / box centers / starting values
# sdv:    quick SDs (box width)
fit_constrained <- function(t, y, constr, mode, center, sdv) {
  use_frac  <- any(c("frac_A1", "frac_A2") %in% constr)
  int_names <- if (use_frac) c("C", "frac_A1", "k1", "frac_A2", "k2", "A3", "s")
               else          c("C", "A1",      "k1", "A2",      "k2", "A3", "s")
  pv <- center

  C0       <- min(max(y[which.min(t)], 0), 1)
  plateau0 <- mean(tail(y[order(t)], max(3, round(length(y) * 0.1))))

  if (use_frac) {
    base <- c(C = C0, frac_A1 = max(pv[["frac_A1"]], 1e-3), k1 = pv[["k1"]],
              frac_A2 = max(pv[["frac_A2"]], 1e-3), k2 = pv[["k2"]], A3 = NA, s = NA)
  } else {
    base <- c(C = C0, A1 = max(pv[["A1"]], 1e-3), k1 = pv[["k1"]],
              A2 = max(pv[["A2"]], 1e-3), k2 = pv[["k2"]], A3 = NA, s = NA)
  }
  base[constr] <- pv[constr]
  nat0 <- to_natural_con(replace(base, c("A3", "s"), 0))
  base[["A3"]] <- max(plateau0 - (nat0[["C"]] + nat0[["A1"]] + nat0[["A2"]]), 1e-3)

  lower <- setNames(rep(0, 7), int_names)
  upper <- setNames(rep(Inf, 7), int_names)
  upper[c("C", "s")] <- 1

  if (mode == "bounded") {
    for (nm in constr) {
      lower[[nm]] <- max(lower[[nm]], pv[[nm]] - n_sd_bounds * sdv[[nm]])
      upper[[nm]] <- min(upper[[nm]], pv[[nm]] + n_sd_bounds * sdv[[nm]])
      if (upper[[nm]] <= lower[[nm]]) upper[[nm]] <- lower[[nm]] + 1e-8
    }
  }

  fixed_names <- if (mode == "fixed") constr else character(0)
  free_names  <- setdiff(int_names, fixed_names)

  template <- NULL
  resid_fn <- function(q) {
    par <- template
    par[names(q)] <- q
    y - predict_tri(to_natural_con(par), t)
  }

  s_grid <- unique(pmin(1, (1 / start_tau_grid(t)) / max(base[["k2"]], 1e-12)))

  outs <- lapply(s_grid, function(s0) {
    start <- base
    start[["s"]] <- s0
    start <- pmin(pmax(start, lower), upper)
    template <<- start
    out <- tryCatch(nls.lm(par = start[free_names], lower = lower[free_names],
                           upper = upper[free_names], fn = resid_fn,
                           control = nls_control),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(out)) {
      q <- template
      q[names(out$par)] <- out$par
      out$q_full <- q
    }
    out
  })

  best <- pick_best(outs)
  if (best$status != "ok") return(list(status = best$status))
  par <- to_natural_con(best$out$q_full)
  list(status = "ok", par = par, rss = sum((y - predict_tri(par, t))^2))
}

derive_params <- function(p) {
  C <- p[["C"]]
  A <- c(p[["A1"]], p[["A2"]], p[["A3"]])
  k <- c(p[["k1"]], p[["k2"]], p[["k3"]])
  tibble(
    C = C, A1 = A[1], A2 = A[2], A3 = A[3],
    k1 = k[1], k2 = k[2], k3 = k[3],
    tau_1 = 1 / k[1], tau_2 = 1 / k[2], tau_3 = 1 / k[3],
    frac_A1 = A[1] / (1 - C), frac_A2 = A[2] / (1 - C), frac_A3 = A[3] / (1 - C),
    frac_unrecovered = 1 - sum(A) / (1 - C),
    plateau = C + sum(A)
  )
}
```

## Run the bootstrap

Discard rules (as in the original scripts), checked in this order:
`fit_failed`, `hit_iteration_limit`, `plateau_too_high` (C + A1 + A2 + A3 >
`max_plateau_sum`), `rate_at_lower_bound` (k3 = 0, tau_3 undefined). Discarded
fits that did return parameters keep them in the saved csv, but only `kept`
iterations go into the violins and tests.

```{r bootstrap-run}
iteration_file <- function(cl) {
  file.path(export_folder, paste0(cl, "_", channel_to_model,
                                  "_slow_triexp_bootstrap_iterations.csv"))
}

run_one_cell_line <- function(cl) {
  cd <- slow_curves %>% filter(cell_line == cl)

  # ROI x frame matrix (one row per ROI); averaging = column means of drawn rows
  frame_time <- cd %>% group_by(frame) %>% summarize(time = first(time), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(frame)
  wide <- cd %>%
    select(curve_id, frame, ratio_targeted_to_untargeted) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = frame, values_from = ratio_targeted_to_untargeted)
  mat <- as.matrix(wide[, as.character(frame_time$frame)])
  n_rois <- nrow(mat)

  med <- quick_median(cl)
  sdv <- quick_sd(cl)
  qpool <- quick_boot %>% filter(cell_line == cl)

  message(sprintf("Bootstrapping %s: %d ROIs, %d iterations, %d versions ...",
                  cl, n_rois, n_bootstrap_iterations, nrow(versions)))

  rows <- vector("list", n_bootstrap_iterations * nrow(versions))
  r <- 0

  for (iter in seq_len(n_bootstrap_iterations)) {
    if (iter %% 100 == 0) message(sprintf("  %s: iteration %d", cl, iter))

    idx <- sample.int(n_rois, n_rois, replace = TRUE)
    y_all <- colMeans(mat[idx, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    keep_pts <- is.finite(y_all) & frame_time$time >= bleach_time
    t <- frame_time$time[keep_pts] - bleach_time
    y <- y_all[keep_pts]

    # one quick draw per slow iteration, shared by all "random" versions
    q_i  <- sample.int(nrow(qpool), 1)
    drawn <- setNames(unlist(qpool[q_i, quick_names]), quick_names)

    for (v in seq_len(nrow(versions))) {
      ver <- versions[v, ]

      res <- if (ver$family == "unconstrained") {
        fit_unconstrained(t, y)
      } else {
        center <- if (ver$source == "median") med else drawn
        fit_constrained(t, y, families[[ver$family]], ver$mode, center, sdv)
      }

      status <- res$status
      der <- NULL
      if (status == "ok") {
        der <- derive_params(res$par)
        status <- if (der$plateau > max_plateau_sum) "plateau_too_high"
                  else if (der$k3 <= 0)              "rate_at_lower_bound"
                  else                               "kept"
      }

      row <- tibble(
        cell_line = cl, iteration = iter, version = ver$version,
        family = ver$family, mode = ver$mode, source = ver$source,
        quick_iteration = if (ver$source == "random") q_i else NA_integer_,
        n_unique_rois = length(unique(idx)), n_points = length(y),
        status = status,
        RSS = if (is.null(der)) NA_real_ else res$rss,
        k3_at_k2 = if (is.null(der)) NA else
          isTRUE(abs(der$k3 - der$k2) <= 1e-8 * max(der$k2, 1e-12)),
        k1_below_k2 = if (is.null(der)) NA else der$k1 < der$k2
      )
      if (!is.null(der)) row <- bind_cols(row, der)

      r <- r + 1
      rows[[r]] <- row
    }
  }
  bind_rows(rows)
}

if (run_bootstrap) {
  boot <- map_dfr(bootstrap_cell_lines, function(cl) {
    out <- run_one_cell_line(cl)
    write_csv(out, iteration_file(cl))
    out
  })
} else {
  missing_files <- bootstrap_cell_lines[!file.exists(map_chr(bootstrap_cell_lines, iteration_file))]
  if (length(missing_files) > 0)
    stop("run_bootstrap = FALSE but no saved iterations for: ",
         paste(missing_files, collapse = ", "))
  boot <- map_dfr(bootstrap_cell_lines,
                  ~ read_csv(iteration_file(.x), show_col_types = FALSE))
}

boot <- boot %>%
  mutate(cell_line = factor(cell_line, levels = bootstrap_cell_lines),
         version   = factor(version, levels = version_levels),
         status    = factor(status, levels = names(status_colors)))

boot_kept <- boot %>% filter(status == "kept")
```

## Fit status per version

```{r status-plot, fig.width=14, fig.height=9}
status_counts <- boot %>% count(cell_line, version, status, .drop = FALSE)

status_counts %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = n) %>%
  knitr::kable()

ggplot(status_counts, aes(x = version, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  facet_wrap(~ cell_line, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = status_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = paste0(channel_to_model, " - bootstrap fit status"),
       subtitle = paste0(n_bootstrap_iterations, " iterations per version"),
       x = NULL, y = "Number of iterations", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

### Flags among kept iterations

`k3_at_k2`: k3 ended up equal to k2 (no separate slower timescale; the k3
distribution is then capped by k2). `k1_below_k2`: fast-component ordering
flipped (possible in bounded versions, and in "random" versions when the drawn
quick iteration itself had k1 < k2).

```{r flags}
boot_kept %>%
  group_by(cell_line, version) %>%
  summarize(n_kept          = n(),
            pct_k3_at_k2    = 100 * mean(k3_at_k2),
            pct_k1_below_k2 = 100 * mean(k1_below_k2),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 1)
```

## Goodness of fit (RSS)

Kept iterations only, one plot per comparison. RSS also reflects how noisy each
cell line's average curve is, so differences between cell lines are not only
differences in fit quality.

```{r rss-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
comp_name <- function(pr) paste(pr[1], "vs", pr[2])

for (pr in comparisons) {
  d <- boot_kept %>%
    filter(cell_line %in% pr) %>%
    mutate(cell_line = factor(as.character(cell_line), levels = pr))
  if (nrow(d) == 0) next

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = version, y = RSS, fill = cell_line)) +
    geom_violin(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75, scale = "width",
                trim = TRUE, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
    stat_summary(aes(group = cell_line), fun = median, geom = "crossbar",
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.3,
                 color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = version_levels, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cell_line_colors) +
    expand_limits(y = 0) +   # y axis starts at 0
    labs(title = paste0(channel_to_model, " - RSS per bootstrap fit: ", comp_name(pr)),
         x = NULL, y = "RSS", fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
  print(p)
}
```

## Tests

For each comparison, version and parameter, `P(A > B)` over all pairings of
kept iterations (from ranks, i.e. Mann-Whitney U / (nA × nB)), two-sided
p = 2 × min(P, 1 − P), floored at 1 / min(nA, nB).

* **Not tested at all**: `untested_params` (empty by default; any parameter
  listed there is still shown in the violin plots).
* **Holm family**: the parameters in `holm_params` (C, frac_A1, frac_A2,
  frac_A3, frac_unrecovered, tau_1, tau_2, tau_3) that are estimated from the
  slow data in that version. Holm-corrected within each comparison and version.
  There is no additional correction for the three comparisons.
* **Not corrected** (tested, but not part of the Holm family):
  * amplitudes A1, A2, A3 and rates k1, k2, k3
  * parameters from the quick fit (held or bounded, and anything computed only
    from them). Held ("fixed") parameters are tested only in the "random"
    versions; in the "median" versions they are the same value every
    iteration, so no test. Bounded parameters vary within their box and are
    tested in both sources.

```{r tests}
param_deps <- list(C = "C", A1 = "A1", A2 = "A2", A3 = "A3",
                   k1 = "k1", k2 = "k2", k3 = "k3",
                   tau_1 = "k1", tau_2 = "k2", tau_3 = "k3",
                   frac_A1 = c("C", "A1"), frac_A2 = c("C", "A2"),
                   frac_A3 = c("C", "A3"),
                   frac_unrecovered = c("C", "A1", "A2", "A3"))

param_status <- function(prm, family, mode) {
  if (family == "unconstrained") return("estimated")
  constr <- families[[family]]
  if (!(prm %in% constr || all(param_deps[[prm]] %in% constr))) return("estimated")
  if (mode == "fixed") "inherited (fixed)" else "tied (bounded)"
}

p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(is.na(p) ~ "NA", p < 0.001 ~ "***", p < 0.01 ~ "**", p < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns")
}

compare_two <- function(a, b) {
  a <- a[is.finite(a)]; b <- b[is.finite(b)]
  na <- length(a); nb <- length(b)
  if (na < 2 || nb < 2) return(NULL)
  r    <- rank(c(a, b))
  prob <- (sum(r[seq_len(na)]) - na * (na + 1) / 2) / (na * nb)
  tibble(n1 = na, n2 = nb, median1 = median(a), median2 = median(b),
         prob_1_greater = prob,
         p_raw = 2 * min(prob, 1 - prob), p_floor = 1 / min(na, nb))
}

kept_long <- boot_kept %>%
  select(cell_line, version, family, mode, source, all_of(violin_params)) %>%
  mutate(cell_line = as.character(cell_line)) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(violin_params), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(param_class = pmap_chr(list(parameter, family, mode), param_status))

tests <- map_dfr(comparisons, function(pr) {
  kept_long %>%
    filter(cell_line %in% pr,
           !parameter %in% untested_params,
           !(param_class == "inherited (fixed)" & source == "median")) %>%
    group_by(version, family, mode, source, parameter, param_class) %>%
    group_modify(function(d, key) {
      res <- compare_two(d$value[d$cell_line == pr[1]], d$value[d$cell_line == pr[2]])
      if (is.null(res)) tibble() else res
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(comparison = comp_name(pr), group1 = pr[1], group2 = pr[2], .before = 1)
}) %>%
  mutate(p_is_floor = p_raw < p_floor,
         p_value    = pmax(p_raw, p_floor),
         in_holm    = param_class == "estimated" & parameter %in% holm_params) %>%
  group_by(comparison, version) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = {
    pa <- p_value                                   # not in the Holm family: uncorrected
    pa[in_holm] <- p.adjust(p_value[in_holm], "holm")
    pa
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(significance = p_to_stars(p_adj),
         p_adj_label  = paste0(ifelse(p_is_floor, "<", ""), sprintf("%.3g", p_adj)),
         comparison   = factor(comparison, levels = map_chr(comparisons, comp_name)),
         version      = factor(version, levels = version_levels),
         parameter    = factor(parameter, levels = violin_params)) %>%
  arrange(comparison, parameter, version)

tests %>%
  select(comparison, parameter, version, param_class, median1, median2, prob_1_greater,
         p_value, p_adj = p_adj_label, holm_corrected = in_holm, significance) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 4)

write_csv(tests, file.path(export_folder,
                           paste0(channel_to_model, "_slow_triexp_bootstrap_tests.csv")))
```

## Minimum significant difference D (power estimate)

For each comparison, version and tested parameter: the difference between the
two cell lines that would just reach p = `D_alpha` (≈ 50 % power), read from the
distribution of all pairwise differences first − second:

* observed difference `d_obs` = median of the pairwise differences
* if `d_obs >= 0`: `D = d_obs - q(D_alpha / 2)` (distance from the center to the
  lower `D_alpha / 2` quantile)
* if `d_obs < 0`: `D = q(1 - D_alpha / 2) - d_obs` (distance to the upper quantile)

`D` is an absolute difference (same units as the parameter), independent of
where the observed difference lies: any true difference of at least `D` in
that direction would come out significant at `D_alpha` (uncorrected, i.e. not
taking Holm into account). It assumes the spread of the differences does not
change when the difference grows. Shown as a bar plot under each violin plot.

```{r min-sig-diff}
min_sig_diff <- function(a, b, alpha = D_alpha) {
  a <- a[is.finite(a)]; b <- b[is.finite(b)]
  if (length(a) < 2 || length(b) < 2) return(NULL)
  diffs <- as.vector(outer(a, b, "-"))
  d_obs <- median(diffs)
  q     <- quantile(diffs, c(alpha / 2, 1 - alpha / 2), names = FALSE)
  D     <- if (d_obs >= 0) d_obs - q[1] else q[2] - d_obs
  tibble(d_obs = d_obs, q_lower = q[1], q_upper = q[2], D = D,
         already_significant = abs(d_obs) >= D)
}

D_keys <- tests %>% distinct(comparison, group1, group2, version, parameter)

D_all <- pmap_dfr(D_keys, function(comparison, group1, group2, version, parameter) {
  dv  <- kept_long %>% filter(version == !!version, parameter == !!as.character(parameter))
  res <- min_sig_diff(dv$value[dv$cell_line == group1], dv$value[dv$cell_line == group2])
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  tibble(comparison = comparison, version = version, parameter = parameter) %>%
    bind_cols(res) %>%
    mutate(direction = if_else(d_obs >= 0, paste(group1, ">", group2),
                               paste(group1, "<", group2)))
}) %>%
  mutate(comparison = factor(comparison, levels = map_chr(comparisons, comp_name)),
         version    = factor(version, levels = version_levels),
         parameter  = factor(parameter, levels = violin_params)) %>%
  arrange(comparison, parameter, version)

write_csv(D_all, file.path(export_folder,
                           paste0(channel_to_model, "_slow_triexp_bootstrap_min_sig_diff.csv")))

# bar plot of D for one parameter and comparison, same x axis as the violins
plot_D_bar <- function(prm, pr, vers) {
  d <- D_all %>% filter(parameter == prm, comparison == comp_name(pr), version %in% vers)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
  ggplot(d, aes(x = version, y = D)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "grey55", color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = vers, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = paste0(channel_to_model, " - ", prm, ": ", comp_name(pr),
                        " - minimum significant difference"),
         subtitle = paste0("D for p = ", D_alpha, " (~50 % power, uncorrected); ",
                           "no bar = not tested"),
         x = NULL, y = paste0("D (", prm, ")")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}
```

## Violin plots per parameter and comparison

Kept iterations; line = median. Shade of the cell-line color: full = estimated
from the slow data; lighter = bounded around the quick value; lightest = held
at the quick value. Above each pair: significance of the comparison
(Holm-corrected for the Holm family; marked `°` = uncorrected: amplitudes A,
rates k, or parameter from the quick fit). No label = not tested.

```{r violin-function}
dodge_w <- 0.8

# log10 y axis starting exactly at log_y_lower, ticks and labels at powers of ten
log_y_scale <- function() {
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(log_y_lower, NA),
                breaks = 10^(-6:9),
                labels = scales::trans_format("log10", scales::math_format(10^.x)),
                expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)))
}

# Violins of one parameter for the two cell lines of one comparison, for the
# versions in `vers`, with the test result above each pair.
# log_y = FALSE: linear y axis that starts at 0 (or lower, if values are negative).
# log_y = TRUE:  log10 y axis (only positive values can be shown).
plot_param_violin <- function(prm, pr, vers, log_y = FALSE) {
  d <- kept_long %>%
    filter(parameter == prm, cell_line %in% pr, version %in% vers, is.finite(value)) %>%
    mutate(cell_line   = factor(cell_line, levels = pr),
           param_class = factor(param_class, levels = names(status_alpha)))
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)

  span <- diff(range(d$value)); if (!is.finite(span) || span == 0) span <- max(abs(d$value), 1e-9)

  br <- tests %>%
    filter(parameter == prm, comparison == comp_name(pr), version %in% vers) %>%
    mutate(version = as.character(version)) %>%
    inner_join(d %>% mutate(version = as.character(version)) %>%
                 group_by(version) %>% summarize(y_max = max(value), .groups = "drop"),
               by = "version") %>%
    mutate(x  = match(version, vers),
           x1 = x - dodge_w / 4, x2 = x + dodge_w / 4,
           y  = y_max + 0.06 * span,
           label = paste0(significance, ifelse(in_holm, "", "°")))

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = version, y = value, fill = cell_line)) +
    geom_violin(aes(alpha = param_class, group = interaction(version, cell_line)),
                position = position_dodge(width = dodge_w), width = 0.75,
                scale = "width", trim = TRUE, color = "grey15", linewidth = 0.4) +
    stat_summary(aes(group = cell_line), fun = median, geom = "crossbar",
                 position = position_dodge(width = dodge_w), width = 0.3,
                 color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = vers, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cell_line_colors) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = status_alpha, drop = FALSE, name = "Shade",
                       guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey30"))) +
    labs(title = paste0(channel_to_model, " - ", prm, ": ", comp_name(pr)),
         x = NULL, y = prm, fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical")

  if (nrow(br) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_segment(data = br, aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y),
                   inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_text(data = br, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.3, size = 3.2) +
      geom_blank(data = br, aes(x = x, y = y + 0.08 * span), inherit.aes = FALSE)
  }
  if (log_y) p + log_y_scale() else p + expand_limits(y = 0)
}
```

```{r violins, fig.width=11, fig.height=5.5}
for (prm in violin_params) {
  for (pr in comparisons) {
    p <- plot_param_violin(prm, pr, version_levels)
    if (!is.null(p)) print(p)
    pD <- plot_D_bar(prm, pr, version_levels)
    if (!is.null(pD)) print(pD)
  }
}
```

## Optional: the selected fit (`diff_plot_version`)

Only runs when `diff_plot_version` is set.

### How the p-values are derived

For each comparison and each tested parameter: the histogram of all pairwise
differences first − second cell line (every kept iteration of the first paired
with every kept iteration of the second). The share of pairs right of 0 is
P(first > second), the share left of 0 is 1 − P (exact ties count half). The
smaller side is shaded; the raw p-value is twice the shaded share (then floored
at 1 / n). Holm correction, where it applies, is done afterwards and is given as
text only. The blue dashed line marks the minimum significant difference D
(see the D section below), in the direction of the observed difference.

```{r diff-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
if (!is.null(diff_plot_version)) {

  if (!diff_plot_version %in% version_levels)
    stop("diff_plot_version must be one of: ", paste(version_levels, collapse = "; "))

  for (pr in comparisons) {
    g1 <- pr[1]; g2 <- pr[2]

    t_sel <- tests %>% filter(version == diff_plot_version, comparison == comp_name(pr))
    if (!is.null(diff_plot_params)) t_sel <- t_sel %>% filter(parameter %in% diff_plot_params)
    if (nrow(t_sel) == 0) { message("No tested parameters for ", comp_name(pr)); next }

    bins_list  <- list()
    annot_list <- list()

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(t_sel))) {
      prm <- as.character(t_sel$parameter[i])
      dv  <- kept_long %>% filter(version == diff_plot_version, parameter == prm)
      a <- dv$value[dv$cell_line == g1]; a <- a[is.finite(a)]
      b <- dv$value[dv$cell_line == g2]; b <- b[is.finite(b)]

      diffs <- as.vector(outer(a, b, "-"))
      rng <- range(diffs)
      if (diff(rng) == 0) next

      # 0 is always a bin edge, so every bin is clearly left or right of 0
      brks <- seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out = 81)
      if (rng[1] < 0 && rng[2] > 0) brks <- sort(unique(c(brks, 0)))
      h <- hist(diffs, breaks = brks, plot = FALSE)

      prob <- t_sel$prob_1_greater[i]
      smaller_side <- if (prob < 0.5) "right" else "left"   # side holding the smaller share

      # minimum significant difference D (same definition as in the D section
      # below), drawn in the direction of the observed difference
      d_obs <- median(diffs)
      q     <- quantile(diffs, c(D_alpha / 2, 1 - D_alpha / 2), names = FALSE)
      D     <- if (d_obs >= 0) d_obs - q[1] else q[2] - d_obs
      D_x   <- if (d_obs >= 0) D else -D

      bins_list[[length(bins_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        parameter = prm,
        xmin = head(h$breaks, -1), xmax = tail(h$breaks, -1),
        share = h$counts / length(diffs)
      ) %>%
        mutate(side   = if_else((xmin + xmax) / 2 > 0, "right", "left"),
               shaded = side == smaller_side)

      annot_list[[length(annot_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        parameter = prm,
        D_x = D_x,
        label = paste0(
          "P(", g1, " > ", g2, ") = ", sprintf("%.3f", prob), "\n",
          "raw p = 2 x ", sprintf("%.3f", min(prob, 1 - prob)), " = ",
          sprintf("%.3g", t_sel$p_raw[i]),
          if (t_sel$p_is_floor[i]) paste0(" -> floored to ", sprintf("%.3g", t_sel$p_value[i])) else "",
          "\n",
          if (t_sel$in_holm[i]) paste0("Holm-adjusted p = ", sprintf("%.3g", t_sel$p_adj[i]))
          else "not Holm-corrected",
          "\n", "D (p = ", D_alpha, ") = ", sprintf("%.3g", D_x)
        )
      )
    }

    if (length(bins_list) == 0) next
    bins  <- bind_rows(bins_list)  %>% mutate(parameter = factor(parameter, levels = violin_params))
    annot <- bind_rows(annot_list) %>% mutate(parameter = factor(parameter, levels = violin_params))

    p <- ggplot(bins) +
      geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = 0, ymax = share, fill = shaded),
                color = NA) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      geom_vline(data = annot, aes(xintercept = D_x),
                 linetype = "dashed", color = "#377EB8", linewidth = 0.7) +
      geom_text(data = annot, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
                hjust = -0.03, vjust = 1.1, size = 2.8) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#E41A1C", `FALSE` = "grey65"),
                        labels = c(`TRUE` = "smaller side (p = 2 x this share)",
                                   `FALSE` = "larger side"),
                        name = NULL) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.45))) +
      facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
      labs(title = paste0(channel_to_model, " - ", diff_plot_version,
                          ": pairwise differences ", g1, " - ", g2),
           subtitle = paste0("All pairs of kept bootstrap iterations; black dashed = 0; ",
                             "blue dashed = difference needed for p = ", D_alpha,
                             " (D, uncorrected)"),
           x = paste0(g1, " - ", g2), y = "Share of pairs") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
    print(p)
  }
}
```

### Violins of the selected fit

One plot per parameter and comparison, showing only `diff_plot_version`.
Above each plot: the median of the plotted values (kept iterations) for both
cell lines. Parameters in `log_y_params` (tau_3) get a log10 y axis here and in the
exported PDFs, starting at `log_y_lower` (1) with ticks at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, ...;
all others a linear y axis starting at 0.

```{r selected-violins, fig.width=4.5, fig.height=5.5, results="asis"}
if (!is.null(diff_plot_version)) {
  sel_params <- if (is.null(diff_plot_params)) violin_params else diff_plot_params
  for (prm in sel_params) {
    for (pr in comparisons) {
      p <- plot_param_violin(prm, pr, diff_plot_version, log_y = prm %in% log_y_params)
      if (is.null(p)) next

      # median of the plotted values (kept iterations), per cell line
      med <- kept_long %>%
        filter(version == diff_plot_version, parameter == prm,
               cell_line %in% pr, is.finite(value)) %>%
        group_by(cell_line) %>%
        summarize(median = median(value), n_kept = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
        mutate(cell_line = factor(cell_line, levels = pr)) %>%
        arrange(cell_line)

      cat("\n\n**", prm, ": ", comp_name(pr), "**  \n",
          paste0("median ", med$cell_line, " = ", signif(med$median, 4),
                 " (n = ", med$n_kept, ")", collapse = "; "),
          "\n\n", sep = "")

      print(p + labs(subtitle = diff_plot_version))
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  }
}
```

### Minimum significant difference D

D for the selected fit, taken from the D values computed for all versions
(see "Minimum significant difference D" above the violin plots): table, and one
bar plot per parameter with the three comparisons.

```{r min-sig-diff-selected, fig.width=5, fig.height=4.5, results="asis"}
if (!is.null(diff_plot_version)) {
  D_sel <- D_all %>% filter(version == diff_plot_version)
  if (!is.null(diff_plot_params)) D_sel <- D_sel %>% filter(parameter %in% diff_plot_params)
  cat("\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(D_sel %>% arrange(parameter, comparison), digits = 5))
  cat("\n\n")

  # one bar plot per parameter: D for the three comparisons
  for (prm in levels(droplevels(D_sel$parameter))) {
    d <- D_sel %>% filter(parameter == prm)
    p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = comparison, y = D)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "grey55", color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.3) +
      scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
      labs(title = paste0(channel_to_model, " - ", prm, ": minimum significant difference"),
           subtitle = paste0(diff_plot_version, "; p = ", D_alpha, " (~50 % power)"),
           x = NULL, y = paste0("D (", prm, ")")) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
    print(p)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

### Composition of the recovery

One pair of stacked bars per comparison, from the kept bootstrap iterations of
the selected fit:

* **C and 1 − C**: median of C, and 1 − median(C) on top, so each bar adds up
  to 1. Error bar: ± 1 SD of C across iterations, at the top of the C segment.
* **Fractions**: medians of frac_A1, frac_A2, frac_A3 and frac_unrecovered
  stacked (frac_A1 at the bottom). Each fraction's error bar (± 1 SD across
  iterations) is drawn at the top of its own segment. A negative median
  frac_unrecovered is not drawn (with a warning). Because each fraction's
  median is taken separately, the stack does not have to add up to exactly 1.

Both plots, and the single-version violins of `pdf_violin_params`, are saved as
PDFs in `export_folder/pdf_selected_fit/<version>/`.

```{r composition-plots, fig.width=4.5, fig.height=5.5, results="asis"}
if (!is.null(diff_plot_version)) {

  safe_name   <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
  sel_pdf_dir <- file.path(export_folder, "pdf_selected_fit", safe_name(diff_plot_version))
  dir.create(sel_pdf_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  frac_comp   <- c("frac_A1", "frac_A2", "frac_A3", "frac_unrecovered")
  frac_alpha  <- c(frac_A1 = 1, frac_A2 = 0.7, frac_A3 = 0.45, frac_unrecovered = 0.2)
  C_alpha     <- c("C" = 0.9, "1 - C" = 0.25)

  sel_stats <- boot_kept %>%
    filter(version == diff_plot_version) %>%
    mutate(cell_line = as.character(cell_line)) %>%
    group_by(cell_line) %>%
    summarize(n_kept = n(),
              across(all_of(c("C", frac_comp)),
                     list(median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), sd = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
                     .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
              .groups = "drop")

  cat("\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(sel_stats, digits = 4))
  cat("\n\n")

  # stacked bars drawn as rectangles: x = position of the cell line in the pair
  stacked_plot <- function(seg, err, alpha_vals, title, ylab) {
    ggplot() +
      geom_rect(data = seg, aes(xmin = x - 0.35, xmax = x + 0.35, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,
                                fill = cell_line, alpha = component),
                color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_errorbar(data = err, aes(x = x, ymin = y - sd, ymax = y + sd),
                    width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.5) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(unique(seg$cell_line)),
                         labels = unique(seg$cell_line), expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cell_line_colors, guide = "none") +
      scale_alpha_manual(values = alpha_vals, name = NULL,
                         guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey30"),
                                              reverse = TRUE)) +
      labs(title = title, subtitle = diff_plot_version, x = NULL, y = ylab) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
  }

  for (pr in comparisons) {
    st <- sel_stats %>% filter(cell_line %in% pr) %>%
      mutate(x = match(cell_line, pr)) %>% arrange(x)
    if (nrow(st) < 2) { message("Missing kept iterations for ", comp_name(pr)); next }

    # ---- C and 1 - C ----
    seg_C <- bind_rows(
      st %>% transmute(cell_line, x, component = "C",     ymin = 0,        ymax = C_median),
      st %>% transmute(cell_line, x, component = "1 - C", ymin = C_median, ymax = 1)
    ) %>% mutate(component = factor(component, levels = names(C_alpha)))
    err_C <- st %>% transmute(x, y = C_median, sd = C_sd)

    pC <- stacked_plot(seg_C, err_C, C_alpha,
                       paste0(channel_to_model, " - C and 1 - C: ", comp_name(pr)),
                       "Fraction of pre-bleach intensity")
    print(pC)
    cat("\n\n")
    ggsave(file.path(sel_pdf_dir, paste0("C_composition_", safe_name(comp_name(pr)), ".pdf")),
           pC, width = 4.5, height = 5.5, device = "pdf")

    # ---- fractions ----
    seg_list <- list(); err_list <- list()
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(st))) {
      cl  <- st$cell_line[j]
      med <- unlist(st[j, paste0(frac_comp, "_median")]); names(med) <- frac_comp
      sdv <- unlist(st[j, paste0(frac_comp, "_sd")]);     names(sdv) <- frac_comp

      comps <- frac_comp
      if (!is.finite(med[["frac_unrecovered"]]) || med[["frac_unrecovered"]] < 0) {
        warning(sprintf("%s (%s): median frac_unrecovered = %.4f is negative - not plotted.",
                        cl, diff_plot_version, med[["frac_unrecovered"]]))
        comps <- setdiff(comps, "frac_unrecovered")
      }
      tops <- cumsum(med[comps])
      seg_list[[j]] <- tibble(cell_line = cl, x = st$x[j], component = comps,
                              ymin = c(0, head(tops, -1)), ymax = tops)
      err_list[[j]] <- tibble(x = st$x[j], y = tops, sd = sdv[comps])
    }
    seg_F <- bind_rows(seg_list) %>% mutate(component = factor(component, levels = frac_comp))
    err_F <- bind_rows(err_list)

    pF <- stacked_plot(seg_F, err_F, frac_alpha,
                       paste0(channel_to_model, " - fractions of the bleached amount: ",
                              comp_name(pr)),
                       "Fraction of 1 - C")
    print(pF)
    cat("\n\n")
    ggsave(file.path(sel_pdf_dir, paste0("fractions_composition_", safe_name(comp_name(pr)), ".pdf")),
           pF, width = 4.5, height = 5.5, device = "pdf")
  }

  # ---- single-version violins as PDFs ----
  for (prm in pdf_violin_params) {
    for (pr in comparisons) {
      p <- plot_param_violin(prm, pr, diff_plot_version, log_y = prm %in% log_y_params)
      if (is.null(p)) next
      ggsave(file.path(sel_pdf_dir, paste0("violin_", prm, "_", safe_name(comp_name(pr)), ".pdf")),
             p + labs(subtitle = diff_plot_version), width = 4.5, height = 5.5, device = "pdf")
    }
  }

  cat("\n\nPDFs saved in `", sel_pdf_dir, "`:\n\n",
      paste0("* ", list.files(sel_pdf_dir), collapse = "\n"), "\n", sep = "")
}
```

### All four cell lines in one plot

For each parameter in `all_lines_params` (tau_3): one violin plot of the
selected fit with all four cell lines, in the order `all_lines_order`. The
brackets are the three comparisons that are already tested above
(HOXC10 vs HOXC13, HOXC10-13-10 vs HOXC10, HOXC13 vs HOXC13-10-13), with exactly
the same p-values and stars as in the per-comparison plots and the tests csv
(Holm within each comparison's family; `°` = uncorrected). No new tests are run.
Parameters in `log_y_params` get a log10 y axis. Exported as a PDF to the same
`pdf_selected_fit/<version>/` folder.

```{r all-lines-violins, fig.width=6, fig.height=5.5}
if (!is.null(diff_plot_version)) {

  safe_name   <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
  sel_pdf_dir <- file.path(export_folder, "pdf_selected_fit", safe_name(diff_plot_version))
  dir.create(sel_pdf_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  for (prm in all_lines_params) {
    log_y <- prm %in% log_y_params

    d <- kept_long %>%
      filter(version == diff_plot_version, parameter == prm,
             cell_line %in% all_lines_order, is.finite(value)) %>%
      { if (log_y) filter(., value > 0) else . } %>%
      mutate(cell_line   = factor(cell_line, levels = all_lines_order),
             param_class = factor(param_class, levels = names(status_alpha)))
    if (nrow(d) == 0) { message("No kept iterations for ", prm); next }

    y_max <- max(d$value)
    span  <- diff(range(d$value)); if (!is.finite(span) || span == 0) span <- max(abs(y_max), 1e-9)

    # brackets of the already tested comparisons; brackets that overlap are stacked
    br <- tests %>%
      filter(version == diff_plot_version, parameter == prm) %>%
      mutate(x1 = match(group1, all_lines_order), x2 = match(group2, all_lines_order)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(x1), !is.na(x2)) %>%
      mutate(xa = pmin(x1, x2) + 0.05, xb = pmax(x1, x2) - 0.05,
             label = paste0(significance, ifelse(in_holm, "", "°"))) %>%
      arrange(xb - xa, xa)   # short brackets first, so longer ones are stacked above
    if (nrow(br) > 0) {
      lvl <- integer(nrow(br))
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(br))) {
        prev <- which(seq_len(nrow(br)) < i & br$xb > br$xa[i] & br$xa < br$xb[i])
        lvl[i] <- if (length(prev) == 0) 1L else max(lvl[prev]) + 1L
      }
      br$level <- lvl
      br <- br %>% mutate(
        y       = if (log_y) y_max * 1.25^level       else y_max + 0.06 * span * level,
        y_blank = if (log_y) y_max * 1.25^(level + 1) else y_max + 0.06 * span * (level + 1)
      )
    }

    p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = cell_line, y = value, fill = cell_line)) +
      geom_violin(aes(alpha = param_class), width = 0.75, scale = "width", trim = TRUE,
                  color = "grey15", linewidth = 0.4) +
      stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.3,
                   color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cell_line_colors, guide = "none") +
      scale_alpha_manual(values = status_alpha, drop = FALSE, name = "Shade",
                         guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey30"))) +
      labs(title = paste0(channel_to_model, " - ", prm, ": all cell lines"),
           subtitle = diff_plot_version, x = NULL, y = prm) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")

    if (nrow(br) > 0) {
      p <- p +
        geom_segment(data = br, aes(x = xa, xend = xb, y = y, yend = y),
                     inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
        geom_text(data = br, aes(x = (xa + xb) / 2, y = y, label = label),
                  inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.3, size = 3.2) +
        geom_blank(data = br, aes(x = (xa + xb) / 2, y = y_blank), inherit.aes = FALSE)
    }
    p <- if (log_y) p + log_y_scale() else p + expand_limits(y = 0)

    print(p)
    ggsave(file.path(sel_pdf_dir, paste0("violin_", prm, "_all_cell_lines.pdf")),
           p, width = 6, height = 5.5, device = "pdf")
  }
}
```
